newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $768 mln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $768 mln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday were expected to total $768 million in 26 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $487 million in nine sales, with a $162 million Hawaii Housing offering through Merrill Lynch & Co., topping the list.
On the competitive side, 17 sales totaling $282 million are scheduled. A $125 million Washington refunding, offering at 1130 EDT is the largest.
An additional four sales totaling $68 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
